title: Lapwing you are
html_source: The Lapwing (Vanellus Vanellus) is a summer visitor to Ireland from France and Iberia. Stephen Dedalus will soon fly back to Europe. “lapwing be.”

anchor.prefix:
gan. 

 Fabulous artificer. The hawklike man. You flew. Whereto? Newhaven-Dieppe, steerage passenger. Paris and back. Lapwing. Icarus. Pater, ait. Seabedabbled, fallen, weltering.
anchor.suffix:
. Lapwing be.
